definitions.explanation: All human beings collectively. Used to discuss humans as a species or civilization as a whole.

examples.japanese: {人類|じんるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧です。
⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人類|じんるい}⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{課題|かだい}→課題：00132_kadai⟧です。
examples.english: Environmental issues are challenges for all of humanity.

examples.japanese: {人類|じんるい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。

notes:
{人類|じんるい} refers to all human beings as a species — humanity, mankind. It has a broad, elevated tone and is used when discussing humans collectively.

COMPOUNDS:
⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person) + ⟦{類|るい}→類：15121_rui⟧ (class, kind). Literally "the human class."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人類|じんるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧: human history
- {人類|じんるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧: humanity's future
- {人類|じんるい}⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: all of humanity
- {人類|じんるい}⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧: for humanity
- {人類|じんるい}⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧: a first for humanity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧: human being (can refer to individuals or humanity; broader use)
- {人類|じんるい}: humanity as a species (always collective, never individual)
- ⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧: people (a group of individuals)

REGISTER:
Used in formal, academic, or grand-scale discussions: science, history, philosophy. In casual speech, ⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧ is more natural.
